verdict.rationale: SES is fundamentally an API/SMTP-driven service with no GUI dependency: docs show sending via AWS SDKs, direct API calls, or SMTP from EC2 or any server (amazon-ses-docs-1/19/36), IAM-based programmatic access control (amazon-ses-docs-16), and building automated pipelines like autoresponders/support-ticket systems (amazon-ses-docs-33) — all consistent with headless/CI use. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, official CLI tool docs, or independent hands-on reports of running SES in automated build pipelines.
